CIRCUIT
Rounds: 8m
AMRAP #1
20    Pulse Squats
20    DB Plank Pull Through
10    DB half burpee row
Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press (Left)

CIRCUIT
Rounds: 8m
AMRAP #2
10    Reverse Crunches
10    Narrow Squat, hammer curl, front raise
12    Narrow Stance Snatch
Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press (Right)

"Circuit"
1. Pulse Squats 20 reps
* AMRAP #1, 8 min rounds
2. DB Plank Pull Through 20 reps
* AMRAP #1, 8 min rounds
3. DB Half Burpee Row 10 reps
* AMRAP #1, 8 min rounds
4. Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press
* Left, AMRAP #1, 8 min rounds
5. Reverse Crunches 10 reps
* AMRAP #2, 8 min rounds
6. Narrow Squat, Hammer Curl, Front Raise 10 reps
* AMRAP #2, 8 min rounds
7. Narrow Stance Snatch 12 reps
* AMRAP #2, 8 min rounds
8. Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press
* Right, AMRAP #2, 8 min rounds
